implementation.scope: New portfolio-comparison-scope owns a WeakMap keyed by exact trusted context plus AsyncLocalStorage lexical identity. A separate overlapping caller cannot join it. Explicit nested composition within the current invocation may reuse it; all proofs are removed in finally.
implementation.keys: Complete cloned comparison request including target case/alternatives/criteria, plus the entire call kind/binding digest. Original request digest and Request identity/signal are checked after awaited work. Wrong selected case does not qualify for caching.
implementation.proofs: Only completed status-ok canonical results are stored. No Promise, authorization decision, source resolver result or incomplete producer work is memoized. Values are structured-cloned on storage and reuse.
implementation.eligibility: Only criterion-free cases with no choices, prepared changes, receipts, ledger or questions; scenarios have no operations; component source surfaces must be Planner; all case/basis/assumption/scenario/result/coverage evidence must be Planner planner-version record refs. Unsupported cases always call the full canonical producer and do not enter the proof map.
implementation.granular_authority: Every fence reopens every distinct eligible source with the real plannerSources.resolveForecastSource and requires complete evidence-ref equality. Full C08/source hashes alone never authorize document, HR, calculation, Procurement, receipt or command dependencies.
implementation.fence: Each real source-read sequence is surrounded by two fresh C08 samples. Samples check actual selected case and actor, hash complete C08 state plus all three domain fences, UTC day and binding. Complete state includes preferences, audit, transactions and native runs; no fields are ignored to preserve reuse across writes.
implementation.last_await: Each sample observes its second UTC clock and final host revalidation inside the C08 read scope; state.read performs its own egress authority check. After state.read only synchronous scope/Request/binding checks occur. Source resolvers and compareCanonical run only after C08 closes, since resolveForecastSource may update source metadata.
implementation.statuses: A missing final authority fence or invalid Request/lease/scope returns denied without value. An observed changed digest with still-valid scope returns stale without value. Existing full producer failures are preserved on uncached paths.
implementation.composition: portfolio-authority preserves readMetric unchanged and names the original producer compareCanonical. Its selection.register/read/inspect wrappers open the scope. An optional own withComparisonScope callback lets decision-alternative capture/draft/replay share only their current lexical invocation. The same shared selection.read function remains visible to DecisionDomain.
implementation.expected_cost_change_not_measured: For the supported unchanged fixture, register needs two canonical productions because its C08 commit invalidates the precommit proof; the repeated postcommit compare may reuse. Two selection reads in a capture may share one canonical production instead of four. Source authorization/fence reads still run on every reuse. Hosted W12 must establish actual counts and latency.
